calculation.description: Ranks assets for contrarian exposure to medium and short residual performance versus the equal-weight 15-asset benchmark, volatility scaled and activated only when cross-asset dispersion is above its trailing 120-day 60th percentile. The one-day lag prevents look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark-wide absolute IC and ICIR gates. Positive across available 2024-2033 regime slices; weaker but passing in 2027-2029. Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
validation.methodology: Daily Spearman cross-sectional IC using at least 8 valid tradable assets; prices visible through 2033-06-23 only.
